correctness.rationale: All finite rank-two ordered bases divide by |GL_2(q)|; support components force a single projective-line direction and rank-one matrices are explicitly removed, including the empty-support correction. The cycle transfer trace includes the all-one correction. The dominant positive root of X^2-(1+w)X-qw is strictly larger in modulus than all other exponential terms near w=q-1, yielding a uniform analytic mgf expansion. Differentiation gives explicit mean density and strictly positive variance stated in the theorem; characteristic-function convergence proves the CLT. Actual packaged verifier exhaustively checks small prime-field cases and recurrence identities. Groups require odd prime fields and subgroups containing the derived subgroup.

value.rationale: Two-dimensional quotient abelian subgroups are the first nontrivial commutator-constrained subgroup stratum of graphical class-two groups. The new linear transfer recurrence counts the precise labelled vertex support and shows that a uniformly sampled subgroup has Gaussian support fluctuations with explicit field-sensitive constants, including a golden-ratio limiting density. This supplies an interpretable typical-structure invariant for an infinite natural cycle family and answers a concrete efficient-enumeration and asymptotic gap; it is not an arbitrary fixed parameter computation.
